text_raw: Tswanda dzinokwana kuita gumi dzakarukwa zvakanakisa dzichisanganiswa mavara. Tswanda idzi dzine mizera  yakasiyana, pane dzimwe dzakati kurei, dzimwe dzakakura zvishoma nedzimwe diki.

text_raw: Mugwagwa wakagadzirwa nehunyanzvi unoratidza kuti wakawaridzwa zvidhina zvakaforomwa ne simende . Mumugwagwa umu mune vanhu vano sanganisira varume nevakadzi varikufamba zvavo.  Mujinga macho mune vamwe vakatsveta zvinhu pamatafura varikuratidza kuti varikutengesa.  Vakazvivharira zuva nematende makuru akaita sema amburera.

text_raw: Chimiro chinoratidza kuti chikoro, kana kuti midhuri inogona kunge ichishandiswa sechikoro. Yakapendwa neruvara rweyero nerutsvuku muzasi, uye pane mihomba inoratidza kuti inosimwa maruva, nemiti mikuru uye mavheranda ekuvanda zuva nemvura.
